SCWDB Issues RFP for Kentucky AI Workforce Readiness Network

The South Central Workforce Development Board is accepting proposals from qualified organizations to design, deliver, maintain and continuously improve live, instructor-led artificial intelligence training for eligible dislocated workers participating in the proposed Kentucky AI Workforce Readiness Network.

The selected contractor will provide two short-duration training services: an AI Industry Accelerator with occupational pathways in manufacturing, construction, logistics, healthcare and business operations, and an AI-Powered Career Readiness workshop. Training must be available both in person and through live remote instruction.

Proposals must be received by 4:00 p.m. Central Time on Friday, September 18, 2026.

Written questions are due by 4:00 p.m. Central Time on August 28, 2026.

View and download the complete RFP below.

Questions and proposals must be submitted to contact@southcentralworkforce.com

SCWDB Issues RFP for AI-Powered Career Readiness Workshop Services

The South Central Workforce Development Board is accepting proposals from qualified organizations to design and deliver a hands-on career-readiness workshop that teaches eligible job seekers how to use artificial intelligence responsibly and effectively during the job-search process.

The workshop will address AI-supported job-search strategy, resumes, applications, professional communication, interview preparation, safe prompting, privacy, accuracy and ethical use.

Proposals must be received by 4:00 p.m. Central Time on Friday, August 21, 2026.

Written questions are due by 4:00 p.m. Central Time on August 7, 2026.

View and download the complete RFP below.

Questions and proposals must be submitted to contact@southcentralworkforce.com
